products.title: Taking down Bigger Opponents by Jay Rodriguez
products.body:
Rising Superstar Jay Rodriguez Teaches His Unique Takedown System He Uses To Defeat Bigger Opponents With Much More Experience!
  • Build a battle-proven takedown system with West Coast ADCC Trials Champion Jay Rodriguez who deployed a formidable takedown gameplan on his way to submitting EACH of his six opponents.
  • Learn next level concepts for wrestling larger opponents including advantageous setups, keys to off balancing, and even how to mentally exhaust them!
  • Develop a clear pathway to the back with Rodriguez’s easy-to-learn system for getting behind opponents with a variety of arm drags, duck unders, slide bys, among other high-level attacks.
  • Master the rear body lock and for opponents to accept the takedown or open up to defend, which leads DIRECTLY to fight-ending back takes!
  • Keep opponents guessing with hard-to-stop ankle picks that come from a wide range of fakes, feints, and angle changes.
  • Chain the system together to develop a non-stop approach to takedowns as you blend between outside shots, body locks, rear body locks, mat returns, back takes and more with grappling phenom Jay Rodriguez!
